params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1. A professional restaurant kitchen at night, the head chef station is empty and waiting: a clean white chef jacket hangs on a hook, a folded chef hat and a chef knife lie on the steel counter, copper pans hang above, one warm lamp over the station. The upper 50% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people. Deep coffee-brown shadows (#0B0907), warm practical light, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze. No readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no green.
